seekFix.correction: Seek, readiness, pause/play, loop and source generations retire registered callbacks. Every callback checks its captured generation and source plus native compositor-submission freshness. The current drawable seek frame is copied with playback-sampled precision until a matching fresh native callback is observed. Source replacement binds during the React layout phase and clears the prior texture.
